messages:
Ivy L: Quick follow-up from mobile QA. On narrow widths (around 600-660px) the console sidebar sometimes covers the table action column instead of pushing content. Repro: open Runs table, tap hamburger, then tap outside.

Noah M: Hmm. Our current behavior toggles between full overlay (<600) and push (>720) with a hard cutoff at 600. Devices like small tablets sit in the gap and get inconsistent layouts.

Priya R: UX suggestion: introduce a soft breakpoint range (600-680) where the sidebar transitions to a translucent overlay with a blurred backdrop and a condensed header instead of full push. That keeps context and avoids hiding action buttons.

Ivy L: Love the translucent overlay idea. It feels less jarring. Also observed that long strings in the "Source" column cause a horizontal scroll at 640px. We should clamp cell height to 2 lines and add a "View" micro-action that opens a panel.

Noah M: Technical note: making the sidebar overlay translucent means we must set pointer-events properly so the underlying table doesn't intercept taps. Also ensure backdrop has sufficient contrast for accessibility.

design-bot: Accessibility reminder: when using a condensed header show a visible focus indicator and ensure the "View" micro-action is reachable by keyboard. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the transition.

Priya R: Copy nit: current condensed header reads "Models" which is ambiguous. Proposal: show current model name with a small down-chevron and aria-expanded on toggle. Short and descriptive.

Ivy L: Agree. Also for the table clamp, implement long-press to reveal full text on touch and a title attribute for desktop hover. Add role="dialog" for the panel and focus-trap when open.

Noah M: I'll prototype CSS for the clamp: `.cell { display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden; }` and add a tiny JS helper to show the view-panel.

accessibility-bot: Contrast check: translucent backdrop at 50% over light table fails AA for text overlays. Recommend 70% darken or add a semi-opaque strip behind nav labels.

Priya R: Good catch. Update: we'll use 72% backdrop and keep nav labels on a solid pill. Action items: Noah to prototype overlay + clamp (EOD), Ivy to run another repro on a set of foldables, Priya to update copy and aria attributes, design-bot to validate reduced-motion. We'll regroup in the design sync.

Ivy L: Thanks everyone — tagging this for follow-up and I'll attach the small screen recording in the doc. :thumbsup:
